title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - SoilTensiometer
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/SoilTensiometer. A sensor that measures the soil moisture. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary (saref:measuresProperty, saref:hasValue, etc.) is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01SoilSensor02 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9: this SoilTensiometer observes SoilMoisture with a measured value of 1 490,0 (om:millibar).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SoilTensiometer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

observes.description: Property/Relationship. saref:observes. The s4agri:Property named individual this sensor measures: 'the amount of water or humidity contained in the soil'. IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/SoilMoisture.

hasFeatureOfInterest.description: Relationship. saref:hasFeatureOfInterest. The Soil (or Parcel) this measurement is about.

value.description: Property. saref:hasValue. The last soil-moisture (tension) measurement reported by the sensor, e.g. 1 490,0 per the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2 example.

unitCode.description: Property. saref:isMeasuredIn. The unit of measure for 'value', e.g. 'millibar' (om:millibar), per the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2 example.

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time this measurement was made.

isSubSystemOf.description: Relationship. ssn:hasSubSystem (inverse). The System this sensor is a component/subsystem of, e.g. the ex:ArvalisIrrinovStation01 irrigation station in the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2 example.
